title: SeRV: Semantic-Aligned Residual Vector Quantization for American Sign Language Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: American Sign Language (ASL) generation remains challenging due to limited paired text-ASL motion data and the difficulty of learning motion representations both precise for reconstruction and predictable from linguistic input. Existing methods rely on motion tokenizers optimized for reconstruction, without explicit semantic supervision from paired text. As a result, the learned tokens remain limited in supporting semantically consistent and fine-grained ASL motion generation. To address this limitation, we propose SeRV (Semantic-Aligned Residual Vector Quantization), a semantic-aligned RVQ tokenizer for ASL generation. SeRV learns a semantically structured residual token space by combining sentence-level motion-text alignment with token-level text-conditioned supervision. Building on this tokenizer, a Hierarchical GPT predicts residual motion tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, generating structurally coherent and semantically aligned

translated_title: SeRV：面向美国手语生成的语义对齐残差向量量化
translated_abstract: 美国手语（ASL）生成仍然面临挑战，原因在于配对的文本-ASL动作数据有限，以及难以学习既对重建精确又能从语言输入进行预测的动作表示。现有方法依赖于仅针对重建优化的动作分词器，缺乏来自配对文本的显式语义监督。因此，所学习到的分词在支持语义一致且细粒度的ASL动作生成方面能力有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出了SeRV（语义对齐残差向量量化），一种用于ASL生成的语义对齐RVQ分词器。SeRV通过将句子级的动作-文本对齐与分词级的文本条件监督相结合，学习一个语义结构化的残差分词空间。基于该分词器，层次化GPT以由粗到细的方式预测残差动作分词，生成结构连贯且语义对齐的……
tldr: 该论文提出SeRV语义对齐残差向量量化分词器，通过句子级动作-文本对齐与分词级文本条件监督学习语义结构化的残差分词空间，并结合层次化GPT由粗到细地预测动作分词，实现语义一致且细粒度的美国手语动作生成。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SeRV, a semantic-aligned residual vector quantization tokenizer that learns a semantically structured residual token space by combining sentence-level motion-text alignment with token-level text-conditioned supervision, together with a Hierarchical GPT that predicts residual motion tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner to achieve semantically consistent and fine-grained American Sign Language generation.
